name: SyMo Launcher
description:
Shows CPU and RAM usage in the top panel with the SyMo icon right after installation.

The full SyMo app adds graphs, power actions, a shutdown timer and Telegram/Discord notifications: https://github.com/OlegEgoism/SyMo
While the SyMo app is running it shows its own tray icon and this indicator hides, so there is always a single SyMo icon.
